page.layout: One printed page, on the right of the scan: a title page with every line centred. The left page is blank apart from handwritten shelf and library notes, which are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Omnibus, cuiuscunque etiam conditionis, ordinis, & status, domi militiæque, terrâ marique, vltro citroque euntibus, lectu vtilis ac verè proficuus.
Dn. FRIDERICVM iunior. Com. Palat. Rheni: &c.
Autor ex grauissimis, cum antiquis tum recentioribus, Historicis, Philosophis & Medicis.
Typis Ioannis Albini, Impensis Conradi Meullii

page.notes: The "R" before TRACTATVS is a large decorative initial, and the "A" of ANIMI is a decorative capital; both are kept as printed. The two printer's ornaments between the author lines and the place line (a pair of fleurons) carry no letters and are not transcribed. The left page is blank apart from handwriting (1736, Path 486, Ms. 3734, "Med Diaet Goclenius 87"), which is excluded. The page has no page number, running head or catchword.
